note: Intro text for each Tax Center page. A page is shown only when its item is approved (or in draft-preview builds).

items.title: Tax Center
items.intro: Rates, deadlines, forms, and official tools in one place. Everything here links to the IRS or Ohio agencies, and each page shows when we last reviewed it.

items.title: 2026 tax rates and limits
items.intro: The main federal and Ohio figures for the 2026 tax year: the returns you file in early 2027.

items.title: Tax due dates
items.intro: Key federal, Ohio, and local deadlines for filing 2026 returns and paying 2027 estimated taxes. Not every date applies to everyone.

items.title: IRS forms and publications
items.intro: The forms and guides people ask about most. Each link opens the official IRS page, which always has the current version.

items.title: Refunds and payments
items.intro: Check a refund or make a payment directly with the IRS, the State of Ohio, or your local tax agency. We don’t receive or control refund information.

items.title: Tax glossary
items.intro: Plain-language explanations of common tax terms. These are general definitions, not advice for your situation.

items.title: Your rights as a taxpayer
items.intro: Every taxpayer has ten basic rights when dealing with the IRS, known as the Taxpayer Bill of Rights. Here they are in brief.

items.title: How long to keep tax records
items.intro: General guidance on how long to keep tax records, based on the IRS’s rules. Some situations call for keeping records longer, so ask us if you’re unsure.

sources.title: IRS: How long should I keep records?

items.title: Check your withholding
items.intro: The IRS Tax Withholding Estimator helps you see whether your employer is withholding the right amount of federal tax from your paycheck. If you owed a lot or got a very large refund last year, it’s worth a look.

items.title: Tax appointment checklist
items.intro: Bring what applies to you. If you’re not sure whether something matters, bring it and we’ll sort it out together. Please don’t email tax documents.
